''See also: [[Caius Agnos Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Caius [[Agnos]], also known as [[Kai]], is a merchant and skilled craftsman who is part of the [[Agnos family]]. A balding man with a warm smile and a muscular build, he often wears a blacksmith's leather apron. While he was previously known as a trader of general supplies throughout the realms of [[Malachi]] and [[Deborah]], he has also demonstrated significant skill in metalworking, such as repairing armor plates and working at a forge. He is married to [[Olissa Agnos]], and together they have two children, [[Lycus]] and [[Andra Agnos|Andra]]. The family had intended to settle on a plot of land near the border, but their lives were disrupted by various conflicts. During a confrontation with an [[Incarnation]], Caius attempted to defend himself with a smith's hammer before being injured. He later suffered a severe wound to his right side that left him in a critical, semi-conscious state, requiring urgent healing.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Caius is the husband of [[Olissa Agnos]]. He is also the father of [[Lycus]] and [[Andra Agnos|Andra]].}}
